title: 第9章 转折第10章 能不能等我们十年
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“不是自己的东西，终究是不能磨合。”看着死的不能再死的狂野星，忆无情淡淡开口。
他的霸天圣体终究是夺舍而来，不能彻底磨合，若是放任不管的话，就算此次他能活着，那到了后面证帝之时也会遭到反噬。
叶河看着下方的已经死亡的狂野星，呢喃一声：“我终于为大家……复仇了……”
他直接从空中落了下来，再无声息。
忆无情走近仔细观察了一番，嗯……还能活着。
忆无情将一株灵药直接塞入叶河的嘴里：“你可不能死，你还没报恩呢，老子还专门让你与狂野星公平一战。”
狂野星手段很多，就单单是刚才那次复活，忆无情若是不帮叶河打出来，那叶河必败。
当然，他帮叶河肯定是有目的的。
忆无情望向某处，神色莫名。
外界现在已经乱了吧。
……
正如忆无情所想，外界现如今已经乱起来了，忆无情杀了许多势力的人，而且连狂龙帝朝的帝子都被斩了，引起了巨大轰动。
“我家帝子自封无数岁月，本以为可盖压同代，没想到竟如此轻易陨落！落天教！我们需要个交代！”
“如若不然，我狂龙帝朝必要与你落天教开战！”
狂龙帝朝之人双眼通红，不可置信，他们自封无数岁月的帝子竟然被一名才修炼了区区数百岁月之人击杀。
他们不敢相信，这还是他们心中可盖压当世天骄的帝子吗？
若是被忆无情杀了也就罢了，毕竟他名声在外，实力非凡，但竟然被名叫叶河的小辈给杀了。
落天教众人也很无奈，但事已至此，也没办法。
“技不如人罢了。”一道苍老的声音响起，守护者出现在众人上方。
见到守护者，众人纷纷安静下来。

他淡漠道：“古路内的一切，都是公平的，无论是谁死了，都是技不如人。”
“可是那忆无情未免太过不可思议，他一人便可镇压我等势力的费心培养的天骄，这不可能！”
一道反对之声响起，一时间，场上再次喧哗起来。
“哼！”
守护者冷哼一声，一时间场上众人都被一股不可反抗的气息压制。
“再说一遍，技不如人罢了，忆无情的实力，是他的造化，他能在古路之内自封，也是他的造化。”
一时间，场上众人都安静了下来。
……
“什么？忆无情将所有人都镇压了？不可能！”
“你是当老夫老糊涂了吗？用此等话术来欺骗老夫？”
“什么！死了？不可能！绝对不可能！”
这一刻，仙界无数势力都收到了来自通天古路的传话，第一时间都是不敢相信。
他们一番寻证之后还是相信了此话，纷纷不敢相信。
但，他们无人敢去质问通天古路的守护者。
他们纷纷派出强者去往通天古路，不是为了找茬，而是为了在通天古路之外，看看能不能等到忆无情的出现。
虽然忆无情很有可能会继续呆在通天古路之内，但他们还是要去碰碰运气。
若是忆无情一直不出来，那就难办了。
若是未来无论什么时候忆无情都会如此行事，那这通天古路还去个屁啊。
若是忆无情不出来，他们只能与守护者商议一番了。
content_en:
"It's not your own thing, and it can't be reconciled after all." Looking at Wild Star, who couldn't die any more, Yi Qingqing said calmly.
After all, his Tyrant Holy Body was taken from his body and could not be completely integrated. If he left it alone, even if he survived this time, he would suffer backlash when he became emperor later.
Ye He looked at the dead Wild Star below and murmured: "I finally got revenge for everyone..."
He fell directly from the sky and made no sound again.
Yi Qingqing walked closer and observed carefully, um... he was still alive.
Yi Qingqing stuffed an elixir directly into Ye He's mouth: "You can't die. You haven't repaid your kindness yet. I also specially asked you to have a fair fight with Wild Star."
Wild Star has many tricks, just the resurrection just now. If Yi Qingqing doesn't help Ye He fight it out, Ye He will definitely lose.
Of course, he must have a purpose in helping Ye He.
Yi Qingqing looked somewhere with an incomprehensible expression.
The outside world is in chaos now.
…
Just as Yi Wuqing thought, the outside world was now in chaos. Yi Wuqing killed many people from different forces, and even the emperor's son of the Kuanglong Emperor Dynasty was beheaded, causing a huge sensation.
"My emperor has been self-proclaimed for countless years. He thought he could surpass his contemporaries, but he didn't expect to fall so easily! Luotian Sect! We need an explanation!"
"If not, our Kuanglong Emperor Dynasty will definitely go to war with your Luotian Sect!"
The eyes of the Kuanglong Emperor Dynasty were red, and they couldn't believe that their self-proclaimed emperor for countless years was actually killed by a person who had only been practicing for hundreds of years.
They couldn't believe it, was this the emperor who they thought could overshadow the most talented people in the world?
It would be fine if he was killed by Yi Qingqing. After all, he was famous and had extraordinary strength, but he was actually killed by a junior named Ye He.
Everyone in the Luotian Sect was also helpless, but at this point, there was nothing they could do.
"My skills are just inferior to those of others." An old voice sounded, and the guardian appeared above everyone.
Seeing the guardian, everyone became quiet.
He said indifferently: "Everything in the ancient road is fair. No matter who dies, his skills are inferior to others."
"But it's unbelievable that Yi Qingqing can suppress the talent that we and other forces have painstakingly cultivated by himself. This is impossible!"
A voice of opposition sounded, and for a while, the field became noisy again.
"Hmph!"
The guardian snorted coldly, and for a moment everyone on the scene was suppressed by an irresistible aura.
"Again, it's just that his skills are inferior to those of others. Yi Wuqing's strength is his destiny. His ability to establish himself within the ancient road is also his destiny."
For a moment, everyone on the field fell silent.
…
"What? Yi Wuqing suppressed everyone? Impossible!"
"Are you thinking that I am an old fool? Are you using these words to deceive me?"
"What! Dead? Impossible! Absolutely impossible!"
At this moment, countless forces in the immortal world received the message from the Tongtian Ancient Road, and they couldn't believe it at first.
After searching for evidence, they still believed this and couldn't believe it.
However, none of them dared to question the guardian of the Tongtian Ancient Road.
They sent strong men to the Tongtian Ancient Road one after another, not to find trouble, but to see if they could wait for Yi Wuqing to appear outside the Tongtian Ancient Road.
Although Yi Qingwu would most likely continue to stay within the Tongtian Ancient Road, they still had to try their luck.
If Yi Qingqing never comes out, it will be difficult to handle.
If Yi Qingqing will act like this anytime in the future, then this ancient road to the sky will be useless.
If Yi Qingqing couldn't come out, they could only discuss it with the guardian.
